item.text: I’ll build the scene with ray-marched SDFs, a connected bicycle, and orbit controls for close inspection from every angle.

The scene design includes a crank, chain, spokes, wing tips on the handlebar, and feet that follow the pedals. I’m adding cursor-centered zoom and panning so the beak and rider contacts can be inspected closely.

The module is about 25 KB and passes JavaScript syntax and shader-structure checks. It uses no external resources or animation loop. Rendering will still need to be verified in the evaluator’s WebGL2 browser.
